description: This file is an installation script for the vtiger CRM system. It performs version checks, includes necessary libraries and configuration files, and dynamically includes another installation-related script based on request parameters.

classes.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing functions for the installation process, such as checking file access permissions.

methods.name: stripslashes_checkstrings
methods.description: A helper function that strips backslashes from strings, used to clean up global request variables when magic quotes are enabled.
